records.outcome_quote: In this overworked and exhausted family who had time any longer to worry about Gregor more than was absolutely necessary?
records.explanation: Father, mother and sister all take up work, but the load is exhausting and Gregor's care is neglected rather than preserved.

records.outcome_quote: The father brought breakfast to the petty officials at the bank; the mother sacrificed herself for the undergarments of strangers
records.explanation: The father had already said the savings would last only a year or two and that they must earn money, and the family then goes to work.

records.outcome_quote: “Gregor, you …” cried out his sister with a raised fist and an urgent glare.

records.outcome_quote: She ran into the room next door to bring some spirits—anything with which she could revive her mother
